title: Design System: Workspace Comedians Director's Console

label.purpose: Operational labels, statuses, and provider metadata.

motion.name: cue-entry
motion.purpose: Subtle round entrance when reduced motion is not requested.

components.name: Primary Cue Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f2c55c; color: #18130b; padding: .65rem .9rem; border: 1px solid #f2c55c; border-radius: 4px; font: 800 1rem ui-serif, Georgia, serif; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff0a5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Operator call-sheet input with warm blackout treatment.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-field" aria-label="Hypothetical">Retry remains disabled after a request fails.</textarea>
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 6rem; resize: vertical; color: #f3eee2; background: #11100d; border: 1px solid #5b5041; border-radius: 4px; padding: .7rem; font: 1rem/1.45 ui-serif, Georgia, serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff0a5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stage Map Frame
components.description: Full-width theory surface for the Archify workflow.
components.css: .ds-stage { min-height: 180px; position: relative; border: 1px solid #5b5041; background: #0e0d0b; } .ds-stage-label { position: absolute; right: .75rem; bottom: .6rem; color: #b9ad9b; background: #15130fde; padding: .3rem .5rem; font: .7rem ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Transcript Cue
components.description: Role-colored observed turn with status and evidence.
components.html:
AbbottDONE
Retry is enabled.

Evidence: one request sent
components.css: .ds-cue { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem 1fr; gap: 1rem; padding: .9rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a342a; color: #f3eee2; } .ds-role { color: #9fb9ff; } .ds-status { display: block; margin-top: .25rem; color: #84d8a2; font: 700 .72rem ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-evidence { color: #b9ad9b; margin: .4rem 0 0; font-size: .92rem; }

narrative.overview: A warm blackout operator console where the Archify map is the stage and observed agent dialogue is the performance. Serif editorial copy, monospaced call-sheet labels, thin rules, and cue colors keep the human director oriented.

rules.name: The Cue-Light Rule
rules.body: Accent colors communicate live state, role, or proof; they are not decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Booth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering and rules instead of shadows or glossy floating cards.

dos: Do keep the stage map above the transcript.
Do preserve visible focus and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't introduce generic dashboard cards or glossy shadows.
Don't flatten the serif/mono editorial pairing into a generic sans-serif UI.
